summary: Junction mouth beside a painted island; no room to stop clear of traffic.
reasons: Stretch lies on junction splitter island

drivers.seclusion: Bush and a path to the south, but the spot is an open junction.
drivers.access_and_room: The 13 m line runs along the chevron island at a junction mouth. No pull-out beside the lane.
drivers.traffic: Through road with a slip lane and island; vans would block turning traffic.
drivers.convention: Cars park along the kerb about 20 m west, past the junction, but not on this stretch.

flags: No Stopping Any Time sign at 9.5 m
Only 13 m long, at a junction
sun_shade: Open to the sun; tree shade from the north-west.
